text:
sam: FYI publishbot skipped the staging -> eu-prod promotion for release/2026.03.19: provenance-check failed for image redwood/inference:2026.03.19.

sam: logs show cosign attestation timed out against eu-ecr. snippet:```time=1714225200 level=error component=publishbot msg=\"attestation fetch failed\" image=redwood/inference:2026.03.19 region=eu-west-1 err=\"timeout calling kms/attest\"```

deploy-bot: AUTO: publish action aborted by publish-guard: provenance_mismatch (code 412). No artifact promoted.

jen: ugh. Is this the same timeout we saw yesterday in eu KMS?

sam: looks related. Yesterday's KMS rotation caused a short window where cosign calls returned 503. But the attestation here is a different digest (manifest mismatch) in the logs too.

artem: can you paste the manifest digest?

sam: manifest reported: sha256:4b2e7f9d... local built digest: sha256:4b2e7f9d... remote attested digest: sha256:9c7a1aa2... so remote attestation doesn't match the built image.

liya: that's worrying — could be a mirror/replication lag or a stale attestation replay from older builds. ops-bot, any replication alerts?

ops-bot: No replication alerts in the last 24h for eu repos. Last mirror job completed at 1714210000.

jen: immediate plan? We have a change window in 2h for eu-prod. Do we roll back the canary or hold the release?

sam: propose: 1) Pin production route to previous pinned digest (sha256:0d3f11aa...) for the change window. 2) Hold the promotion for this tag until we re-run cosign attestation + verify KMS keys. 3) If attestation can't be re-issued within 45m, perform manual retag+re-publish with fresh cosign key and note in release notes.

artem: +1 for pin back. How urgent is the user-facing impact?

sam: low — canary hasn't ramped yet. This would prevent a half-promoted release.

jen: ok pinning sounds safest. who will run the pin?

artem: I can do the pinback and canary hold. command I'll run:```# pin previous digest
deployctl set-image redwood/inference@sha256:0d3f11aa --route eu-prod --reason \"provenance mismatch\"```

sam: after pin, create a rollback note and tag the issue: #release-blocker-provenance. add short release note that promotion was delayed due to cosign attestation mismatch.

deploy-bot: NOTE: once manual actions complete, re-run publishbot with --force-verify to attempt re-attestation. If publishbot still rejects, manual re-publish required.

liya: can we try re-running attestation first against the built artifact in staging? maybe it's a transient KMS flake.

sam: yes I'll re-run attest locally and hit KMS audit logs. expected steps: 1) re-run cosign attest against the built image 2) compare attestation digest 3) if mismatch, request fresh sign with current KMS key.

jen: timeline: artem pins in next 10m, sam runs attest in parallel, we regroup in ~30m. If no clear fix, escalate to a manual re-publish and update release notes + changelog.

artem: starting pin now. ping here when done. :hammer_and_wrench:

sam: running attest attempt now.```$ cosign verify-attestation --key ksm://eu/key-id redwood/inference:2026.03.19
Attestation: failed to fetch STH from KMS (timeout)
```

liya: hitting KMS again looks flaky. we should open a support ticket if it persists beyond the window.

artem: pin completed: previous digest pinned to eu-prod, canary hold enabled. deployctl output:```OK route eu-prod pinned to sha256:0d3f11aa by artem```

jen: thanks. sam, update?

sam: attest still failing. I'll attempt a re-publish using staging-built image + fresh cosign key as a fallback. Will document in release notes if we go that route.

deploy-bot: Reminder: if you force-publish, include the build metadata label `release.origin=manual-republish` and attach cosign sig in artifact-store.

jen: copy. Also add a short note in the release channel and on the changelog: \"promotion delayed: provenance attestation mismatch; pinned to previous digest; next steps ongoing\".

liya: I'll draft the release note blurb. sam, if you do manual re-publish, mention the KMS request id in the ticket.

sam: will do. opening internal ticket now and tagging security for key audit. ticket: INT-3812.

jen: ok loop closed for now. thanks everyone. keep this thread updated with final outcome so docs and release notes reflect the decision. :thumbsup:
